messages:
erin: morning — quick async standup. what I did: prototyped a kernel latch for slot reuse, pushed draft PR #4123. blocker: seeing a p95 regression on microbatch when latch is enabled (~+12ms). today: bisect the kernel change, run bench harness on canary, pair with @devon on cache-evict threshold. :eyes:

devon: saw that regression too. quick profile points at longer mutex hold in batcher path when seq > 512. i'll try shrinking critical section and re-run. opened a tiny patch branch, will link PR in a bit. :pray:

kai: FYI i tuned the KV hot-set eviction for the canary: set hot_ttl_s=30. early numbers: token hit-rate +3%, tail looks stable on staging. pushed config to staging. snippet:

```
kv:
  eviction: lru
  hot_ttl_s: 30
  max_entries_per_shard: 50000
```

manny: bench summary from last night (bench-run-2026-03-19, us-west-2 canary):
- baseline -> canary (latch + kv-ttl-30)
- p50: 12ms -> 13ms
- p95: 45ms -> 57ms
- p99: 120ms -> 140ms
notes: p95 jump aligns with devon's mutex observation at higher seq lengths.

erin: ok — @kai can you hold off on further TTL widening until we have the microbench? @devon please add a targeted microbench for seq=1024 into CI so we catch this earlier. if bench still shows >10% p95 regression we should rollback the latch. :warning:

devon: adding the microbench to the harness now (bench/seq_long_test). will open PR today and tag @manny for a nightly run.

manny: confirmed — i'll run the nightly bench with the new test once the PR lands and drop results here. also i sketched a quick A/B for batching window: window=6ms reduced tail at cost of p50. happy to run both.

oncall-bot: deploy canary -> us-west-2 finished at 09:12 UTC. health checks: all green. logs: no OOMs detected. :white_check_mark:

erin: thanks. blockers? if devon's patch doesn't clear the p95 we should plan a rollback for the kernel latch in the next canary. otherwise proceed with cautious tuning and CI microbench coverage. ping me if anything needs unblock. :thumbsup:
